//Forwards
Erling Haaland, a prolific striker, joined Manchester City in July 2022. His remarkable goal-scoring abilities from clubs like Borussia Dortmund and Red Bull Salzburg have revitalized City\'s attack, leading to a stellar debut season. Haaland\'s impact was immense, setting records in the Premier League and Champions League and securing multiple titles, including the Premier League, FA Cup, Champions League, and UEFA Super Cup—a phenomenal start to his English football career.
Julian Alvarez, the Argentine forward, joined Manchester City at 22, having already played for Argentina. His loan with River Plate showcased his talent before his City debut. Alvarez shone in the 2022 World Cup, scoring four crucial goals, aiding Argentina\'s victory. In his debut City season, he played a pivotal role in winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League, netting 17 goals and five assists in 49 games. His recent Super Cup success against Sevilla underscores his promising future. //MidFielders
Kalvin Phillips rose from Leeds United to become a crucial player under Marcelo Bielsa, helping Leeds return to the Premier League. His swift England debut preceded his move to Manchester City in 2022. Despite initial injuries, Phillips played a vital role in City\'s triumphs, winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League in his debut season. He continued his success, contributing to City\'s Super Cup victory in 2023 24, solidifying his status as a key player for club and country.
Mateo Kovacic, previously at Chelsea, joined Manchester City in 2023 as an experienced deep-lying midfielder. With 221 appearances at Chelsea and a successful history at Dinamo Zagreb, Inter, and Real Madrid, where he won multiple Champions League titles, Kovacic swiftly made an impact at City. He contributed to their Super Cup win and scored a crucial penalty in a shootout, notably lifting the Super Cup and contributing to City\'s victorious spell.
Jack Grealish\'s switch from Aston Villa to Manchester City established him as a top Premier League midfielder. His rise from Villa\'s academy to the senior team showcased his leadership and technical skill. At City, Grealish swiftly won the Premier League in his debut season and played a pivotal role in their historic treble, securing the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League. His consistent excellence for both club and country cements his status as a key figure in English football.
Jeremy Doku, City\'s recent five-year signing from Stade Rennais, made a mark in 92 games over three seasons in Ligue 1. The Belgium international notably featured in the 2020 Euros and 2022 World Cup. Known for his exceptional speed, agility, and dribbling skills, Doku started his career in Antwerp before joining Anderlecht at 10. Despite injury setbacks, he contributed 12 goals and 10 assists during his tenure at Stade Rennais.
Rodrigo, the Spanish midfielder, arrived at City from Atletico Madrid in July 2019, showcasing defensive strength and precise passing in midfield. He contributed significantly to crucial victories, including the Carabao Cup final against Aston Villa and played a vital role in multiple Premier League successes. His influence extended to City\'s FA Cup and Champions League victories, culminating in City\'s historic Treble. Rodrigo\'s impressive form continued into the 2023/24 season.
Kevin De Bruyne, City\'s signing in 2015, made an immediate impact. From Genk to Chelsea and Wolfsburg, his journey shaped him into a force at City. Despite injuries, he consistently shone, earning multiple Player of the Year awards. His recent contract extension underlines his significance. Despite Belgium\'s World Cup disappointment, De Bruyne\'s influence on City remains pivotal, securing consecutive Premier League titles and contributing to FA Cup and Champions League successes. His legacy as one of City\'s greats is undeniable.
Bernardo Silva joined City in 2017, displaying remarkable skill and versatility. Named Bubblegum for his adhesive ball control, his tireless work ethic and adaptability made him invaluable under Pep Guardiola. From Benfica to Monaco, his impressive performances led to a triumphant Ligue 1 win. At City, Silva thrived, contributing to league and cup victories. Across seven seasons, his impact at City was immense, crowned by his pivotal role in securing the historic Treble in 2023.
Matheus Nunes, City\'s summer 2023 signing from Wolves, has earned high praise from Guardiola, who lauds him as "one of the world\'s best." The midfielder began with Estoril in 2018, then moved to Sporting in 2019, amassing 101 appearances with eight goals and nine assists. His notable performances, including winning Premier League Goal of the Month in April 2023, made him a standout at Wolves. Nunes debuted for Portugal in 2021 and appeared twice in the 2022 World Cup.
James progressed through City\'s youth ranks to the EDS and signed his first pro contract in 2020. He made his senior debut in 2021 and has since appeared as a substitute five times across different competitions. Awarded the EDS Players\' Player of the Year in 2021/22, he then enjoyed a successful loan stint at Sheffield United, contributing to their promotion to the top flight. He continued his loan journey with the Blades into the 2023/24 season.
In January 2023, the 20-year-old Argentinian midfielder Perrone joined Manchester City from Velez Sarsfield, showcasing his talent with three goals and two assists in 33 games during his debut season. He played a role in City\'s triumph in the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League. In the 2023/24 season, he continued as a vital part of the team, traveling for the UEFA Super Cup match against Sevilla.
Phil Foden, an academy graduate, swiftly ascended to become an acclaimed English talent at Manchester City. His journey began at age 9, showcasing creative brilliance and technical finesse. Foden\'s rapid rise saw him make his City debut at 17, earning a place in the Champions League squad and winning the U-17 World Cup\'s Golden Ball. As part of City\'s success, he secured Premier League titles and individual honors, culminating in pivotal roles in the historic treble and Super Cup triumph by 2023.
Oscar, signed from Vålerenga in 2019, swiftly proved his worth in Manchester City\'s youth setup. His impressive technical skills and versatility earned him recognition as he progressed from the U18s to the EDS squad. Bobb showcased his talent during the pre-season tour, securing a spot in Pep Guardiola\'s first-team for the 2023/24 season. //Defenders
Kyle Walker, recruited from Tottenham in 2017, swiftly established himself as a dependable right-back at City, winning numerous titles. His career, shaped by loan spells and achievements at Spurs, showcased his consistency and athleticism. A prominent figure for both City and England, Walker\'s defensive prowess and leadership were key in securing trophies and navigating international competitions, including the 2022 World Cup. Despite occasional injuries, he\'s been instrumental in City\'s successes, recently extending his contract until 2026.
Ruben Dias, acclaimed as the Premier League\'s Player of the Season in 2020/21, has solidified his status as a defensive stalwart since joining City in 2020. His commanding presence and unwavering determination on the pitch have significantly bolstered City\'s defensive line, resulting in pivotal victories, multiple titles, and an exceptional Treble triumph in the 2023/24 campaign. Additionally, his influential leadership was pivotal in securing the UEFA Super Cup, marking another milestone in his impressive tenure at the club.
John Stones, emerging from Barnsley\'s academy and flourishing at Everton before joining City in 2016, has been a cornerstone of the team\'s success. His consistent performances, notable versatility, and crucial contributions in major tournaments for England have been pivotal for City\'s consecutive titles and historic Treble win. Stones\' impact continued into the 2023/24 season, culminating in City\'s maiden UEFA Super Cup triumph.
Nathan Ake, signed in 2020, swiftly adapted to Manchester City\'s defense, showing versatility at center-back and left-back. His journey from Chelsea to Bournemouth displayed his adaptability. Injuries initially hampered his City tenure, but he excelled with increased appearances afterward. His post-2022 World Cup performances were pivotal in City\'s FA Cup, Premier League, and Champions League victories. Ake\'s strong start in the 2023/24 season contributed to City\'s historic UEFA Super Cup win.
Joao Cancelo has been a vital asset for Manchester City since his arrival from Juventus in 2019. Known for his versatility and dynamic style of play, he\'s been a key figure in City\'s successes. Despite brief loan spells at Bayern Munich and now Barcelona, Cancelo\'s adaptability, attacking prowess, and influential performances significantly contributed to City\'s achievements, including their FA Cup and Premier League titles.
Sergio joined City in August 2022 from Anderlecht after a successful season. He was impressive at Barcelona, Borussia Dortmund, Huesca, and won Anderlecht\'s Player of the Year award. In his debut City season, he contributed to their Premier League win and aims for more playing time in the upcoming campaign. Sergio also played a crucial role for Spain in the Under-21 Euros and was part of City\'s historic UEFA Super Cup win against Sevilla in August 2023.
Josko Gvardiol, a Croatian defender, joined City from RB Leipzig in August 2023. He showcased remarkable versatility and leadership skills at a young age, having been a key part of Croatia\'s World Cup journey. Gvardiol made an impactful debut in City\'s Super Cup win over Sevilla, contributing to the historic European success.
Manuel Akanji, City\'s Swiss central defender, arrived from Borussia Dortmund in September 2022. He played a crucial role in City\'s triumphant season, winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League. Akanji continued his excellent form into the 2023/24 season, contributing to City\'s Super Cup victory over Sevilla in August 2023, marking his fourth trophy with the club.
Lewis Rico, a versatile talent progressing from City\'s academy, debuted in the senior team at 17. He made history in the Champions League as the youngest goal scorer on his debut start. Rico\'s impact continued with appearances in the Premier League, contributing to City\'s trophy haul in the 2022/23 season: Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League, securing the Treble. He started the 2023/24 season with City\'s UEFA Super Cup victory over Sevilla.
Josh joined City in 2019 and swiftly rose through the ranks, debuting impressively in the Carabao Cup. He later gained valuable experience on loan at Coventry City in the Championship, contributing to their 5th-place finish. Now, he\'s set for a loan spell at Ligue 1\'s Stade de Reims for the 2023/24 season. //Goalkeepers
Stefan arrived at City from Arminia Bielefeld in 2022. Despite Ederson\'s presence, he showcased his skills in cup matches and made his Premier League debut with a clean sheet. He contributed to City\'s successful season, winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and the Champions League, and was part of the squad that won the 2023 Super Cup against Sevilla.
Ederson joined City in 2017, making a significant impact with his remarkable goalkeeping skills and precise distribution. He became a key part of City\'s success, winning multiple Golden Glove awards and achieving his 100th Premier League clean sheet in record time. Ederson\'s crucial saves played a pivotal role in City\'s victories, including the Champions League final win that secured the Treble. In the 2023 UEFA Super Cup, he delivered crucial saves in the penalty shootout, ensuring City\'s victory and their first-ever UEFA Super Cup title.
Scott Carson extended his Manchester City contract till 2024. He brought experience as a goalkeeper and aided City\'s squad, despite limited appearances. Carson was part of City\'s wins in the Premier League, FA Cup, Champions League, and the UEFA Super Cup in 2023.
